data.description:
## Description
**What**: Wire /dso:preplanning to emit an INTENT_ALLOCATION_PREPLANNING: JSON ticket comment on the parent epic (temp-file write). For each story DoD mint a stable intent_id; when reassigning an epic SC to a story, preserve the existing intent_id and set deferred=false. Under --lightweight, still emit the comment and set lightweight=true on unreassigned items (deferred stays true).
**Why**: Carries allocation from epic-level seeds into story-level ownership and introduces the lightweight-placeholder distinction the validator relies on.
**Scope**:
- IN: preplanning emitter; intent_id preservation on reassignment; deferred=false on reassignment; --lightweight lightweight=true behavior on unreassigned items.
- OUT: brainstorm emitter (sc-2); impl-plan emitter (sc-4); validate finding types (sc-6); assistant dispatch (sc-8).

## Done Definitions

- A /dso:preplanning run posts one INTENT_ALLOCATION_PREPLANNING: comment on the parent epic with one entry per story DoD, each carrying a slug-regex intent_id ← Satisfies: sc-3
- When a story DoD reassigns an epic SC, the emitted entry reuses that SC's existing intent_id and sets deferred=false ← Satisfies: sc-3
- A --lightweight run emits the comment and marks each unreassigned item lightweight=true with deferred=true, distinguishing it from a genuine orphan ← Satisfies: sc-3
- When this story is complete, the INTENT_ALLOCATION_PREPLANNING comment is written through ticket-comment-from-file.sh via a temp file rather than an inline argument, so large epics do not hit ARG_MAX ← Satisfies: sc-3
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic in the preplanning emitter, covering reassignment preservation and the --lightweight path ← Satisfies: sc-3

## Considerations

- [Stability] Reassignment MUST preserve the brainstorm-stage intent_id; minting a new id on reassignment would orphan the seed and break stage-precedence merge.
- [ARG_MAX] Route the comment body through a temp file via ticket-comment-from-file.sh; inline JSON in a comment argument breaks on large epics.
- [Concurrency] Concurrent preplanning worktrees can emit conflicting comments; this story emits append-only and leaves conflict surfacing to read.sh (sc-5) — do not attempt in-emitter conflict resolution.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a planner running /dso:preplanning, I want an INTENT_ALLOCATION_PREPLANNING comment that reassigns SCs to story DoDs while preserving intent_ids, so that allocation tracks the decomposition.
